units.source_text: 然而，我发现这些日记的时候，感到不可思议的是，日记里所写的每天的生活，我已了无记忆。

en.t: However, when I found these diaries, what felt strange was that I had no memory at all of the daily life recorded in them.

units.source_text: 要说了无记忆，那么这些日子我到哪儿去了？

en.t: If I truly had no memory of them, then where had I gone during those days?
And where had I disappeared to?

units.source_text: 我思索着这样一个问题：人是不断地消失在过去的日子里的。

en.t: I was pondering this question: people are constantly disappearing into the days that have passed.
